# IMPROX MEDIA

> IMPROX MEDIA LLC is a global YouTube growth and strategy agency founded in 2023. It helps creators, B2B brands and B2C brands grow YouTube channels with channel strategy, packaging (thumbnails and titles), retention, YouTube SEO, Shorts, monetisation and paid media. Headquartered in Savannah, Georgia, USA. Serves clients across the USA, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, India and Europe.

## Services
- [YouTube Growth Strategy](https://improxmedia.github.io/services/youtube-growth-strategy): channel audit, positioning and a 90-day plan.
- [Video Editing & Thumbnails](https://improxmedia.github.io/services/video-editing-thumbnails): retention-focused editing, thumbnails and title tests.
- [YouTube SEO & Channel Audits](https://improxmedia.github.io/services/youtube-seo-channel-audits): keyword research, metadata and playlist structure.
- [Channel Management](https://improxmedia.github.io/services/channel-management): end-to-end channel operations and monthly reporting.

## Proof (verifiable)
- [Focus Plus case study](https://improxmedia.github.io/work/focus-plus): one channel, 8.0M views in the four years before, 112.5M views in 16 months (Jan 2024 to Apr 2025) with no ad spend on the channel, from YouTube Studio reports.
- [Work and results](https://improxmedia.github.io/work): results with who delivered each one.
- Founder track record: 10B+ lifetime views and 100B+ impressions across all social platforms over seven years, including work before the company was founded.
